disputes.topic: Global identity inventory does not match the compiled inventory
disputes.issue: OI lists 12 global_buildings_normalized records and declares 54 total_global_identities. COMPILED_SPEC declares 54 but lists only the 12 shared identities in its scene inventory; the 42 singleton identities (BUILDING-GLOBAL-013..054) have no explicit OI records or scene membership.
disputes.required_resolution: Either supply explicit, provenance-backed records and scene membership for the 42 singleton identities, or revise the declared total and compiled inventory to the identities actually represented. Do not infer or generate the missing identities.
disputes.chunk_scope: This merged packet only; do not treat the count as established by source datasets.
